## Delivery slice

Describe the smallest usable outcome this PR moves forward.

## Scope

- [ ] bounded and coherent change
- [ ] no unrelated refactor/churn
- [ ] project-specific invariants preserved

## Risk / security

Describe security, data, runtime or destructive impact. State `none` when genuinely not applicable.

## Validation

List the applicable deterministic, integration, security, package/runtime and live/acceptance gates that executed.

```text
FAST / QUALITY:
SECURITY:
INTEGRATION / ACCEPTANCE:
EVIDENCE:
```

- [ ] a skipped/not-run gate is not represented as GREEN
- [ ] deterministic failures were root-caused rather than blindly retried
- [ ] no secret/credential/session material is included in the PR or evidence

## Evidence / operability

Record evidence location/digest when applicable and describe rollback/recovery or why it is not applicable.

## Definition of Delivery

- [ ] implemented
- [ ] tested
- [ ] integrated
- [ ] security validated where applicable
- [ ] evidenced
- [ ] operable/live-accepted where applicable
